image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a black cast-iron skillet containing cooked hash browns or shredded potatoes. The pan sits on a stovetop burner. The handle is partially visible on the left side, and the rim of the pan curves around the food. The background shows parts of the stove and kitchen environment.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The pan clearly exhibits a wide diameter relative to its low sidewall height, consistent with a shallow skillet design.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The handle extends out of the frame to the left; the end of the handle and any potential hanging hole are not visible in the image.
The interior walls of the pan curve smoothly from the base to the rim, indicating sloped sides typical for skillets.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Cast iron (black, rough seasoned surface), stainless steel (polished silver), aluminum (brushed or anodized), or non-stick coated (black PTFE surface).

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Material is metal with characteristic finish.

The lines of the stovetop grate in the upper right appear slightly warped or inconsistent with standard geometric perspective, though subtle.
